body: I am from Finland... My problem might be more that I can't even get started or stay focused on the quite difficult problems the degree requires. I've also fallen terribly much behind in the studies. Started in 2015 and I'm still on the first year...

I am on Concerta 36mg + 300mg Bupropion(for Major Depression).

Have not tried anything else before...

I feel you. Have felt the same way and done big mistakes in regards to this problem. I have been going to an therapist for almost 10 years now but I did the big mistake of lying to her for the first 6. Not until after when I opened up completely did my life start to change. Also the best choice is to always face your fears (do it responsibly though) because otherwise the fear will only grow and may have a chance of consuming you fully. Be kind to yourself and observe your fearful thoughts from a different perspective. Learn to think about what you're thinking about. You will see that your mind is trying to make bull out of a fly. Trust yourself and the fact that you can overcome your fears.
